chunks: (Abraham) asked: "Do they hear when you call them?"
ai.seo_question: What did Abraham ask about the idols in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse highlights the logical inconsistency of idolatry by questioning whether false deities can actively hear and respond to human supplications. Shia exegetes often view this as a foundational argument for Tawhid (Divine Oneness), emphasizing that true divinity requires the attribute of 'Sami' (All-Hearing) in a dynamic, responsive sense, unlike the inert statues of polytheism.
